thesis: Test whether a project-first -> exact-CA join plus narrow Jev semantic triage improves early high-information discovery over the frozen current champion without unacceptable Deep-Dive load or critical-evidence loss.

deterministic_stage: extract exact factual primitives and timestamps
architecture.jev_stage: semantic challenger only after deterministic extraction; never identity/provenance/arithmetic/date authority
architecture.ca_join_stage: keep project candidate alive and bind prospectively to exact CA/factory/pool when evidence appears

jev_atomic_questions.question: Does the supplied point-in-time evidence show a concrete product/protocol surface with specific falsifiable mechanics rather than generic marketing?
How specifically is the project coupled to the target chain's native financial or technical primitives?
How falsifiable and externally checkable are the described mechanics from the supplied evidence?
Does this evidence add material project information beyond ticker/name/social excitement already present?
Would the existing specialist Deep Dive machinery likely add useful information to this project candidate?

jev_rules.confidence_policy: confidence may route to retain/escalate only; low confidence must not DROP evidence

arms.champion: existing Alpha Lab discovery policy frozen at preregistration
arms.challenger_a: deterministic project-first discovery + project-to-CA join, no Jev
arms.challenger_b: challenger_a + Jev semantic triage in shadow
arms.challenger_c: reserved for independently proposed adversarial architecture; must be frozen before prospective scoring

primary_endpoints: lead time to exact CA qualified watch
kill_or_redesign_if: Jev adds no preregistered utility over challenger_a
Deep-Dive load rises without recall/precision benefit
gains depend on NET/SAFIX/DARK-like labels or hindsight
identity joins create unacceptable false linkage

claude_red_team_packet.instruction: Assume the proposed project-first -> CA bridge and Jev triage are wrong. Attack overfitting to NET/SAFIX/DARK, identify alpha classes still missed, identify false-positive classes created, propose the smallest alternative or correction, and define falsifiable prospective tests. Do not recommend a parallel scanner, retrospective winner fitting, or trading authority.

implementation_rule: No production code or scheduler change from this preregistration. Actual code write follows canonical CODEX_ONLY routing and independent review.
